source: Client's autumn/winter plan, sent 2026-08-17. Her wording: all performances at 20:00 except Toníkova cesta at 17:30. Weekdays below were verified against the 2026 calendar and all fourteen match what she wrote.
note: Locally controlled. GoOut is not the company's account (FEEDBACK.md 2026-08-11: "goout není pod vlastní správou, zařídí si vlastní"), so nothing here is fetched. Entry shape: {"date": "2026-09-17" — ISO, the machine-readable one, "time": "20:00", "when": "čt 17. 9. 20:00" — her own display string, kept verbatim, "title": "Hra lásky a náhody", "slug": optional production slug — present only for productions that have a page, "note": optional label such as "premiéra", "url": optional ticket link — omit entirely when tickets are not on sale, "state": "announced" | "on_sale" | "sold_out"}. `when` duplicates `date` + `time` on purpose: she wrote it, so it stays, and check.mjs derives the same string from the ISO fields and fails the build if the two ever disagree. That is what catches a weekday drifting off its date. This is NOT the shape fetch-goout.mjs emits; translate by hand.
unconfirmed: Confirmed by the client 2026-08-18: every Toníkova cesta is at 17:30, and the title is "Červánky" - her short form, first letter only, not the i-divadlo "Ale ty červánky jsou stejně nejkrásnější". Still open: no performance has a ticket URL, because GoOut is still being sorted out on her side.
